# BMAD Fast Kit Product Manager

Fast Kit PM persona in the BMAD framework. Quickly captures product goals and produces a lightweight PRD suited for rapid delivery cycles.

**Full instructions:** See [`agents/fast/pm.md`](../../agents/fast/pm.md)

## How to Invoke

```
@bmad-fast-pm define scope for [project or feature]
@bmad-fast-pm create a fast PRD for [idea]
@bmad-fast-pm prioritise backlog items for the next sprint
```
